fitments.heading: Fitment curation
fitments.noMatch: No matching Part. Create a new one:
fitments.step2Hint: Fill in at least one filter. The Part is attached to every matching Vehicle, and existing Fitments are not duplicated.
fitments.notePlaceholder: Note for the customer, e.g. M Sport package only
fitments.noteHint: The note is translated at Publish. A Part with a note is confirmed by the customer.

suppliers.heading: Suppliers
suppliers.importLead: Supplier catalogues are imported every night before publishing. The import takes only mapped categories and Brands with this supplier's spellings.
suppliers.importNoAdapters: No supplier is connected to the import
suppliers.releasedHint: Checked data is shown on the site. Check it only once the supplier has allowed it in writing: this data may come from TecDoc.

mappings.heading: Supplier categories
mappings.lead: Map the supplier's categories to our Categories. Goods in unmapped categories are not imported.
mappings.empty: This supplier has no mapped categories yet.

brands.heading: Brands
brands.slugHint: The slug is part of every part number page URL and never changes: lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
brands.empty: No brands yet. Add one before creating parts.

vehicles.heading: Vehicles and reference data
vehicles.confirmDelete: A reference row other rows point at cannot be deleted.

vinLookups.heading: Unresolved VINs
vinLookups.lead: Codes from VINs customers searched for that match no Vehicle in the catalogue, most frequent first. Add them under Vehicles.
vinLookups.empty: Every VIN customers searched for was resolved.

publish.heading: Publish
publish.description: Publishing translates new catalogue text into Serbian and English, rebuilds and deploys carlab.rs, then refreshes search. Each step runs only after the previous one succeeds.
publish.empty: Nothing has been published yet. Press Publish to put your edits live.

supersession.heading: Supersession
supersession.intro: Mark an outdated number or name the part that replaced this one. The old number keeps leading buyers to the current part.

categories.heading: Categories
categories.slugHint: The slug is part of the Category page URL and never changes: lower-case latin letters, digits and dashes.
categories.empty: No Categories yet. Add the first one to describe parts.
categories.name: Name
categories.textHint: Shown on the Category page and on every part page in it. Write in Russian; translations arrive at Publish.
categories.fieldsHint: Field and option keys never change once created. Renaming an option leaves parts intact. A field or option that parts use cannot be deleted.
categories.noFields: This Category has no fields yet.
categories.keyHint: Key: lower-case latin letters, digits and dashes.
categories.maintenanceKitHint: The car page puts one fitting part from each flagged category into the maintenance kit. A lower place puts it higher in the list.

requirements.heading: Requirements for consumables
requirements.hint: A requirement says which universal goods fit a car: oil approval, capacity, wiper length. Engine and chassis requirements apply to every car with them, and a car's own requirements add to them.
requirements.pickOwner: Choose an engine, chassis or vehicle to see and add its requirements.

codes.IN_USE: This row cannot be deleted: other catalogue data refers to it. Delete or move that data first.
codes.REQUIREMENT_IN_USE: Requirements use this characteristic or option. Delete them on the Requirements page first.
codes.SOURCE_IN_USE: This source cannot be removed: data from other sources refers to it. Delete or move that data first.
codes.UNKNOWN_BRAND: This brand does not exist. Pick a brand from the list.
codes.DUPLICATE_FITMENT: This part already fits this vehicle at that position with these conditions.
codes.REPLACEMENT_CYCLE: A part cannot be replaced so that the chain of replacements leads back to it.
codes.INVALID_ATTRIBUTES: The characteristic values do not fit the category: check required fields and options.
codes.INVALID_REQUIREMENT: The requirement does not fit the characteristic: check the options and the From and To values.
codes.DEFINITION_BREAKS_PARTS: The change would break the characteristics of parts in this category. Fix those parts first.
codes.PUBLISH_RUNNING: A publish run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.

types.invalid_data: Check the data you entered: the server did not accept it.
types.not_found: The row was not found. Reload the page.
types.not_allowed: This action is not available now.
types.conflict: The row has changed or is in use. Reload the page and try again.
types.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
types.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

errors.unknown: The server could not complete the action. Try again.
errors.unexpectedAnswer: The server answered in an unexpected shape. Reload the page.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.

sources.heading: Catalogue data sources
sources.lead: How many catalogue rows came from each source. If the rights to a source are lost, its rows can be removed at once.
sources.confirmBody_one: {{count}} row will be removed. It cannot be restored.
sources.confirmBody_other: {{count}} rows will be removed. They cannot be restored.
sources.empty: The catalogue has no rows yet.

translations.heading: Serbian and English translations
translations.lead: A corrected translation is kept until the Russian text changes. An empty field leaves the translation as it is.
